pr_title: Planner: Avoid injecting redundant projection below LogicalJoin
pr_body:
<!--
Thank you for contributing to TiDB! Please read TiDB's [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document **BEFORE** filing this PR.
-->

### What problem does this PR solve? <!--add issue link with summary if exists-->

Fix #11650 

### What is changed and how it works?

Check whether the projection is necessary, and only inject a necessary projection. 
After this change, `IndexJoin` can be used in this case:
``` mysql
mysql> explain select /*+ TIDB_INLJ(t1) */ t1.a from t t1, t t2 where t1.a = t2.a+1;
+--------------------------+----------+------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| id                       | count    | task | operator info                                                                      |
+--------------------------+----------+------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Projection_7             | 12500.00 | root | test.t1.a                                                                          |
| └─IndexJoin_10           | 12500.00 | root | inner join, inner:TableReader_9, outer key:plus(test.t2.a, 1), inner key:test.t1.a |
|   ├─TableReader_9        | 1.00     | root | data:TableScan_8                                                                   |
|   │ └─TableScan_8        | 1.00     | cop  | table:t1, range: decided by [plus(test.t2.a, 1)], keep order:false, stats:pseudo   |
|   └─Projection_11        | 10000.00 | root | test.t2.a, plus(test.t2.a, 1)                                                      |
|     └─TableReader_13     | 10000.00 | root | data:TableScan_12                                                                  |
|       └─TableScan_12     | 10000.00 | cop  | table:t2, range:[-inf,+inf], keep order:false, stats:pseudo                        |
+--------------------------+----------+------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
7 rows in set (0.00 sec)
```

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

 - Unit test

Code changes

Side effects

 - Change optimizer behaviors.

Related changes

issue_context.title: Planner: Avoid injecting redundant projection when build LogicalJoin
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...] -->

``` mysql
mysql> explain select /*+ TIDB_INLJ(t1) */ t1.a from t t1, t t2 where t1.a = t2.a+1;
+--------------------------+----------+------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| id                       | count    | task | operator info                                                              |
+--------------------------+----------+------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Projection_8             | 12500.00 | root | test.t1.a                                                                  |
| └─HashLeftJoin_9         | 12500.00 | root | inner join, inner:Projection_14, equal:[eq(test.t1.a, plus(test.t2.a, 1))] |
|   ├─TableReader_13       | 10000.00 | root | data:TableScan_12                                                          |
|   │ └─TableScan_12       | 10000.00 | cop  | table:t1, range:[-inf,+inf], keep order:false, stats:pseudo                |
|   └─Projection_14        | 10000.00 | root | test.t2.a, plus(test.t2.a, 1)                                              |
|     └─TableReader_16     | 10000.00 | root | data:TableScan_15                                                          |
|       └─TableScan_15     | 10000.00 | cop  | table:t2, range:[-inf,+inf], keep order:false, stats:pseudo                |
+--------------------------+----------+------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
7 rows in set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

mysql> show warnings;
+---------+------+-----------------------------------------------------+
| Level   | Code | Message                                             |
+---------+------+-----------------------------------------------------+
| Warning | 1815 | Optimizer Hint /*+ TIDB_INLJ(t1) */ is inapplicable |
+---------+------+-----------------------------------------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```

In this case, t1 should  be used as inner table. But the equal condition is `t1.a = t2.a+1`,  we will inject projections at both sides. `Projection(t1.a -> t1.a)` will be eliminated in the last step, but it still exists when considering `IndexJoin` and projection can't be used as inner table.  

**Describe the feature you'd like:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. -->

Avoid injecting meaningless projection when build LogicalJoin.
